Life

You learn to feel the fragile warmth that living things carry between one breath and the next.

Rules

Healing and draining the same life energy; resistance interacts with both.

Ranks 1, 2 and 3 are purchased in order. Rank alone grants no action, attribute bonus, equipment or permission to use every card in this field. A card prints the rank required before purchase. No additional level gate applies to ranks.

Class affinity sets the cost of each rank: Home 1/2/4 DP; Adjacent 2/4/8; Foreign 3/6/12; Opposed 4/8/16. These prices are the agreed starting scheme. No discipline may be bought at level 0.
